issues.description: The title text is cropped to 'UROR', so the required AURORA title is not fully readable on mobile.
A large dark decorative slab sits behind the menu stack and creates an accidental empty region that does not support grouping or content.
The same oversized dark slab behind the centered menu creates a disconnected dead zone and weakens the intended open composition.
The background slab behind the buttons forms an accidental dead zone and makes the compact mobile menu feel visually stranded rather than intentionally framed.
Play is only slightly larger than the secondary buttons and does not read as an unmistakably dominant primary CTA.
The mobile title plate and title text do not reflow safely; the heading clips instead of adapting its size and padding for the narrow viewport.
The close button styling feels heavier and more saturated than the modal body and rows, making it look like a different component tier rather than a compact peer control.
The music row and volume row use different internal inset logic, so labels, control edges, and top padding do not align cleanly across settings peers.
Credits body copy is readable but the line breaks are awkward and create a choppy narrow text block with inconsistent rhythm.
The title plate and menu stack are centered, but the left-leaning background mass competes with that axis and makes the screen feel off-balance.
The composition preserves the central stack, but the decorative left-side mass still outweighs the rest of the screen and dilutes the premium framing.
The gap between title plate and buttons is tight relative to the large empty lower screen, so the mobile stack feels top-heavy rather than evenly paced.

criticalIssues: On phone, the required AURORA title is visibly clipped to 'UROR', which is an immediate readability and prompt-compliance failure.
Desktop, tablet, and phone all show a dominant dark background slab that creates an accidental dead zone instead of restrained supportive decoration.
The Play button is not visually dominant enough to satisfy the requested primary hierarchy.
repairInstructions: Fix mobile title clipping first: reduce AuroraTitle size on phone, increase inner title plate padding, and ensure the full word AURORA fits without truncation.

Remove or drastically reduce the oversized dark background slab behind the menu stack on desktop, tablet, and phone; keep the native dark field and corner ornaments but do not let a decorative block become a false panel.
Strengthen Play as the primary CTA by increasing its height, brightness, and separation from Settings and Credits while keeping the same icon family and button skin language.
Rebalance the mobile vertical rhythm so the title, action stack, and safe-area margins feel intentionally spaced rather than compressed at the top with unused space below.
Normalize settings panel row geometry: align row insets, label baselines, and control anchoring between MusicRow and VolumeRow.
Keep the working cyan/cobalt/navy/gold palette, icon family, panel presence, and readable body text in the credits panel; only refine the failing layout and hierarchy pieces.
Rewrap the credits placeholder copy into fewer, cleaner lines so the compact modal reads as polished rather than mechanically broken by narrow line lengths.

preserve: Preserve the requested feature scope: Play, Settings, Credits, settings controls, credits panel, and close controls only.
Preserve the cyan/cobalt surfaces, navy edging, gold accents, and shared icon family across main buttons and panel close buttons.
Preserve the centered overall stack concept and the compact modal approach on phone-settings and phone-credits.
Preserve the native-looking slider and toggle approach rather than replacing them with decorative fake controls.
modify: Modify AuroraTitle and TitlePlate on phone so the full title fits at mobile size with consistent side padding.
Modify BackgroundRoot decoration on desktop, tablet, and phone to remove the large left-side dark slab and replace it with subtler framing that does not create a dead zone.
Modify PlayButton scale, glow emphasis, and spacing relative to SettingsButton and CreditsButton so primary hierarchy is unmistakable.
Modify MainMenuDock vertical spacing on phone so the stack sits more intentionally within the viewport.
Modify MusicRow and VolumeRow internal layout to share the same left and right insets, header spacing, and control alignment.
Modify CreditsBody wrapping and text box width to improve line rhythm in the compact credits modal.
remove: Remove the oversized dark background block behind the menu stack in desktop, tablet, and phone previews.
Remove any mobile title sizing or constraint setup that truncates the AURORA heading.
add: Add stronger size contrast and possibly a brighter inner highlight to PlayButton while keeping the same skin family.
Add stricter UITextSizeConstraint or responsive padding rules for AuroraTitle on narrow screens.
Add consistent row guides/inset rules for settings content so labels and controls align across rows.
